name: pl-genealogy-record-search
description: Polish and former-Kresy genealogy: match a family tree against Geneteka parish indexes, the Soviet deportation index, cemetery registers and scanned parish books (the Lviv archive's online metrical books included), find which parish a village belonged to, read the Latin and Greek-Catholic registers with a blind second reading of decisive words, log every search including the ones that found nothing, grade every finding, and patch the GEDCOM without breaking it. Python scripts, standard library only, keeping to each site's robots.txt. With a second skill that turns the tree into a private family-tree website (each grandparent's line in its own colour, a path from you to anyone in the tree, an Atlas 3D, a downloadable ancestor picture, a poster configurator for print) and family books: the whole tree or one family's lines, with a fan of every known ancestor, as a PDF for the screen and a print edition with page numbers.
